newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore cat-basher jailed for six weeks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore cat-basher jailed for six weeks.

text.p: The Singapore District Court jailed on Tuesday a Singapore bird lover for six weeks for beating a cat to death with a wooden plank, state television said.
The report said 54-year Tan Kok Hiong admitted to the cruel act of killing the stray cat on December 2 because it was disturbing his pet bird.
A neighbour testified that after hearing a cat's very loud cry, he saw a cat's paw sticking out of a balcony grill and Tan repeatedly hitting the cat with a wooden stick as it lay stuck in the grill.
Just two months ago in a landmark cruelty case, the chief justice sent a dog-beater to jail for a month and levied a fine of S$500 ($350) be paid in compensation to the owner.
